summary: Improved update notifications with foreground priority, always-visible actions, a direct latest-release download link, and clearer mandatory-update urgency.
changelog: Keeps the update window above the main window when the application is opened from its launcher.
Re-presents an existing update notice after later application activations so the main window cannot hide it.
Moves the primary update actions to a fixed area above the scrollable version details and changelog.
Renames the primary action to Download New Version and opens the latest GitHub release directly.
Uses an urgent warning icon and the explicit Mandatory update available heading for required updates.
Keeps Not Now visible but disabled during mandatory updates while retaining Download New Version and Close Application.
